title: Create: Cultivation Craft Fork
description: A Create mod addon that provides a new way for fully automatic crop cultivation.
body:
Create: Cultivation Craft (Patch)

This mod is a fix for Create 6.0.10 on 1.21.1 NeoForge. It resolves a specific error in the current version to keep the mod working correctly.

I did not create this mod. Please visit the original project page to support the developer: https://modrinth.com/mod/create-cultivation-craft


If you have any issues contact me through email. Email: Dockarn94@gmail.com
